reason: I've paid a developer and a portal before and got nothing back, and this still ends in a Rs 60,000 website plus a monthly fee. Rs 5,000 is small, but I've heard 'money back' before, and quoting by hand is slow but it works and doesn't bring me any new buyers.
objection: A small agency I've never heard of wants my full price list and my enquiries, and I'm supposed to trust they'll actually refund me or still be around in a year. Faster quotes don't mean more orders, and I'd still have to check every quote myself.
would_change_my_mind: Speaking directly to a trader in my own line who has used it for a few months and can tell me it won them orders, with no setup fee up front: just pay monthly once it is working.
